# Issue contract: Respect root-path segment boundaries during routing

Implement every enumerated requirement. Preserve unrelated behavior and the public API unless a requirement explicitly changes it.

## R1 — Remove only a complete root-path prefix

When deriving a route path, `get_route_path()` must remove `scope["root_path"]` only when it matches a complete leading path segment or the entire path; a mere character-prefix match must leave `scope["path"]` unchanged.

## R2 — Preserve routes that share the root-path text prefix

With an application root path such as `/root`, routing must still match an application route whose first segment only begins with the same text, such as `/root-queue/path`.

async def echo_paths(request: Request, name: str) -> JSONResponse:
    return JSONResponse(
        {
            "name": name,
            "path": request.scope["path"],
            "root_path": request.scope["root_path"],
        }
    )


async def pure_asgi_echo_paths(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send, name: str) -> None:
    data = {"name": name, "path": scope["path"], "root_path": scope["root_path"]}
    content = json.dumps(data).encode("utf-8")
    await send(
        {
            "type": "http.response.start",
            "status": 200,
            "headers": [(b"content-type", b"application/json")],
        }
    )
    await send({"type": "http.response.body", "body": content})


echo_paths_routes = [
    Route(
        "/path",
        functools.partial(echo_paths, name="path"),
        name="path",
        methods=["GET"],
    ),
    Mount("/asgipath", app=functools.partial(pure_asgi_echo_paths, name="asgipath")),
    Mount(
        "/sub",
        name="mount",
        routes=[
            Route(
                "/path",
                functools.partial(echo_paths, name="subpath"),
                name="subpath",
                methods=["GET"],
            ),
        ],
    ),
]


def test_paths_with_root_path(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None:
    app = Starlette(routes=echo_paths_routes)
    client = test_client_factory(app, base_url="https://www.example.org/", root_path="/root")
    response = client.get("/root/path")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == {
        "name": "path",
        "path": "/root/path",
        "root_path": "/root",
    }
    response = client.get("/root/asgipath/")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == {
        "name": "asgipath",
        "path": "/root/asgipath/",
        # Things that mount other ASGI apps, like WSGIMiddleware, would not be aware
        # of the prefixed path, and would have their own notion of their own paths,
        # so they need to be able to rely on the root_path to know the location they
        # are mounted on
        "root_path": "/root/asgipath",
    }

    response = client.get("/root/sub/path")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == {
        "name": "subpath",
        "path": "/root/sub/path",
        "root_path": "/root/sub",
    }
